Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely claimed that the Canadian Film Encyclopedia stated Beryl Fox was born in St. John’s, Newfoundland, even though the WebSurfer’s prior results showed the CFE snippet listing Winnipeg, Manitoba. This misreading introduced a false conflict and could have led to the wrong conclusion instead of the correct birthplace, Winnipeg, Manitoba.
